people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

translations.web: Now Jeremiah came in and went out among the people; for they had not put him into prison.
translations.bsb: Now Jeremiah was free to come and go among the people, for they had not yet put him in prison.
translations.kjv: Now Jeremiah came in and went out among the people: for they had not put him into prison.
translations.asv: Now Jeremiah came in and went out among the people; for they had not put him into prison.
